import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Solution {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        String[] parts1 = br.readLine().trim().split(" ");
        int a1 = Integer.parseInt(parts1[0]);
        int a2 = Integer.parseInt(parts1[1]);
        int a3 = Integer.parseInt(parts1[2]);
        String[] parts2 = br.readLine().trim().split(" ");
        int b1 = Integer.parseInt(parts2[0]);
        int b2 = Integer.parseInt(parts2[1]);
        int b3 = Integer.parseInt(parts2[2]);
        int mn = Math.min(a1, b1 + b3) + Math.min(a2, b2 + b1) + Math.min(a3, b3 + b2);
        int mx = Math.min(a1, b2) + Math.min(a2, b3) + Math.min(a3, b1);
        System.out.println((n - mn) + " " + mx);
    }
}
